caption: A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
relations: The orange plastic egg is pushed up the plastic slide, rolling forward as it moves against gravity.
Once it reaches the top, the egg loses contact with the pushing force and begins rolling downward under gravity.
The egg accelerates as it descends, maintaining contact with the slide surface throughout its motion.
It rolls to the bottom of the slide and comes to rest at the end of the incline.
